conditions.requirement: Verify beneficial ownership of the proposed collateral lot.
conditions.verification_method: Ownership documents and independently corroborated custody records

conditions.requirement: Confirm no prior lien and first-priority perfected security.
conditions.verification_method: Lien search, executed security documents, and legal confirmation

conditions.requirement: Establish enforceable lender control over the collateral and custody account.
conditions.verification_method: Executed control agreement and operating-procedure test

conditions.requirement: Test the Base-to-liquidation-to-bank repayment route end to end.
conditions.verification_method: Read-only route test with timestamps, fees, and destination confirmation

conditions.requirement: Obtain and reconcile a current 13-week borrowing-entity cash forecast.
Document facility purpose and a controlled use-of-proceeds schedule.
conditions.verification_method: Approved sources-and-uses schedule tied to facility documents

conditions.requirement: Map legal-entity cash ownership and transfer restrictions.
conditions.verification_method: Entity chart, account map, and restriction review

conditions.requirement: Reconcile the complete debt-service and maturity schedule.
conditions.verification_method: Debt schedule tied to agreements, filings, and forecast cash flows

conditions.requirement: Confirm current single-name and shared-risk concentration capacity.
conditions.verification_method: Current portfolio report and limit-owner sign-off

evidence_boundary: Statuses describe the current project evidence set, not a real transaction closing process.
